findings.text: bats_execute now runs with PATH="$BATS_SAVED_PATH", but the patch never defines that variable. It was renamed from BATS_PATH only at this one call site. If BATS_SAVED_PATH is unset, PATH becomes empty, so any command that bats_execute runs by bare name (e.g. `bats_execute sort`) fails with 'command not found'. If something else already sets it, it may hold a different value than the old BATS_PATH. Either way the PATH backup that protects against user path mocks is broken.
